manifest.population: eight fresh pairs preserving each position in the source's eight-position replacement surface design
manifest.selection: All role labels, referents, named principals, slots, and exact surface strings were frozen before tokenizer import. Each fresh pair preserves the semantic and containing-force function of its source position.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus English tokens for all eight frozen pairs under each registered encoding; report the unweighted mean per encoding and the maximum encoding mean as the least-favourable headline.
manifest.freeze: The server retains this manifest before tiktoken import or observation of any new-sample count.

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.
